reason: The application has no capability for deleting a customer record. It publishes only appport.manifest@1, appport.ping@1, billing.contact@1, customers.list@1, customers.lookup@1 (all read-only) and customers.register@1 (creates customers). I can only replace the implementation of an existing capability. I cannot add a capability or change a contract, so changing any existing implementation cannot meet this goal. Repurposing one would also break its contract: for example, making customers.register@1 delete records. Meeting the goal needs a new consequential capability, such as customers.delete@1. Its contract must be defined first: the input (the customer id), the output, the required authorization (presumably customers.write or a new customers.delete scope), declared failures (for example, customer not found), and verification methods. Its effect on dependents must also be decided, since billing.contact@1 reads customer records. Once that contract exists in the application, its implementation can be proposed and verified.
